## Motivation

In an eager prefill or extend forward, a TP MoE layer of GLM-5-Next runs three steps: the AITER fused MoE for the routed experts, the shared expert's GEMMs, and the TP all-reduce. AITER's MegaMoE-TP (`aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp`, ROCm/aiter#5937, in the pinned AITER `285579b6`) runs all three as one persistent kernel. No SGLang code calls it yet. The existing AMD MegaMoE path is expert-parallel (`--moe-a2a-backend megamoe`) and is not touched here.

This PR adds `--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp` (default off). With it, eager extend forwards of 1 to 4096 tokens make one MegaMoE-TP call per MoE layer.

Scope:

- Models: `Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration` (e.g. `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`) with MXFP4 experts on the AITER MoE runner. With the option on, any other model is refused at load. Not reached: the GLM-5 NextN draft model, the other `DeepseekV2MoE` hosts, CUDA and CPU.
- Platform: ROCm, `gfx950`, TP 2 to 8 on one node. Measured: TP 2 with `--disable-shared-experts-fusion` (shared expert appended, below). This is main's TP 2 default: on HIP, main fuses the shared expert only at TP 4 and TP 8. The fused shared-expert layout is accepted and measured at TP 2 with #46578 (below).
- With the option off, `aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp` is not imported and the added hooks return at once.

## Modifications

- New `layers/moe/aiter_mega_moe_tp.py`: gates, shared-expert layout, kernel runner, watchdog and forward hook. It is called from `models/glm5_next.py` (`register` in the decoder layer; the forward hook hands the reduced output to `ffn_boundary.complete_now(..., already_reduced=True)`) and from `model_executor/model_runner.py` (`finalize` after weight loading, not for draft workers).
- The argument and its startup refusals in `arg_groups/` and the server-arguments doc. `SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_MAX_TOKENS` (default 4096) and `SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_COMM_DTYPE` (`fp8`, the default, or `bf16`) in `environ.py`.
- Tests: a CPU test of the per-forward gate, and a 2-GPU test against a PyTorch MXFP4 reference. `benchmark/kernels/aiter_mega_moe_tp/` holds the per-layer microbenchmark below.

Behaviour:

- Routing stays in SGLang (`forward_gate` and `topk`): the kernel's fused router needs `E % 64 == 0`, and E is 289 here.
- An unfused, TP-sharded shared expert is preshuffled like the routed experts and appended as slot E at load; a fused one already is the last slot. One `MegaMoeTP` runtime (`comm_mode="ar"`) serves all MoE layers, with every launch configuration prepared at load.
- Every per-forward gate reads a value that is equal on all TP ranks; each stock-path reason is logged once at INFO.
- With the option on, an unsupported setup raises a `ValueError` naming the reason, at startup (e.g. EP, PP, multi-node, attention DP, TBO, HiCache, LoRA, speculative decoding) or at load (e.g. not `gfx950`, not the `aiter` runner, experts that are not MXFP4 gated SiLU).
- The stock path is kept for CUDA graph capture (including `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable`, opt-in on ROCm), for decode (the kernel was slower than stock per layer at batch 32 and 64), and for forwards above 4096 tokens.
- The kernel is persistent and collective, with a 2 s wait limit fixed in the pinned AITER: if a rank reaches a launch more than 2 s after its peer (a first-use compile, a host stall), the next eligible forward raises and the server ends. This happened three times in our GLM-5.3-Flash serving runs. ROCm/aiter#7024 makes the limit configurable, which needs a newer pin.
- Online weight updates are rejected through the existing `_derived_weight_cache_error` hook, because the kernel binds the startup weights.

## Accuracy Tests

fp8 communication is lossy: the MoE partial outputs are quantized to fp8 before the reduction. `SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_COMM_DTYPE=bf16` keeps them in bf16.

- The added 2-GPU test (TP 2, fp8, small shapes): relative L2 0.047-0.050 and minimum row cosine 0.997 against an fp32 PyTorch reference with the kernel's MXFP4 activation quantization (bound 0.065); identical on both ranks.
- At the GLM-5.3-Flash layer shape (earlier version, same kernel calls), relative L2 against the same kind of reference: stock 0.02, fp8 0.038, bf16 0.003. MegaMoE-TP outputs are bitwise identical across ranks and repeated calls; the stock path's are not (stage-2 atomics).

End to end (setup below): mean probability of the gold answer letter (P(gold)) over 805 single-image multiple-choice MMMU validation items, thinking off, concurrency 1, two patched and two baseline launches per arm, paired by item:

| Arm | Patched − baseline (pp) | 95% CI (pp) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| fp8 | +0.16 | -0.74 .. +1.06 |
| fp8, LB 4 / 2 | -0.20 | -1.08 .. +0.68 |
| bf16, LB 4 / 2 | -0.10 | -0.94 .. +0.75 |
| fp8, shared expert fused (#46578; baseline: #46578 alone) | +0.45 | -0.42 .. +1.32 |

Two baseline launches against each other: +0.85 pp (-0.17 .. +1.88) and +0.56 pp (-0.44 .. +1.57); with #46578, +0.59 pp (-0.50 .. +1.68).

GPQA Diamond with sgl-eval 0.1.3:
- 198 questions × 8 repeats, thinking on (the model's chat template forces it), temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, up to 65536 output tokens.
- One launch per arm, one after the other on the same two GPUs. The server command is the one below, with `--context-length 69632`.

| Arm | pass@1, mean of 8 repeats | Repeats: sd, range | No answer (hit max tokens) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| baseline | 90.59 % | 1.26 pp, 88.9-92.4 % | 2.59 % |
| `--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp` (fp8) | 90.40 % | 1.01 pp, 88.4-91.4 % | 3.09 % |

Paired by question, patched − baseline: -0.19 pp (95% CI -1.52 .. +1.14). That is within the spread of one arm's repeats.

```bash
sgl-eval run gpqa --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1 --model amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4 \
  --num-examples 198 --n-repeats 8 --max-tokens 65536 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261024` with its default environment; SGLang imported through `PYTHONPATH` from base `bf1a2529` (baseline) or this change on that base (patched). AITER `285579b6` (the pin), ROCm 7.2.4. Since measured, the change was rebased onto `316ff4dce2` (its runtime code differs only in a per-layer state holder type and one removed INFO line) and main was merged in (`903b6976e0`); at `903b6976e0` the 2-GPU test passes and a server with the option on serves chat requests.
- 2x MI355X (`gfx950`), TP 2, `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4` at revision `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`.

<summary>Server and benchmark commands</summary>

- Server (patched arms add `--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp`):
  ```bash

    --revision b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07 --quantization quark --tp-size 2 \
    --attention-backend dsa --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang --dsa-decode-backend tilelang \
    --linear-attn-backend triton --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 --moe-runner-backend aiter \
    --disable-shared-experts-fusion --disable-radix-cache --context-length 8192 \
    --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-backend-decode full --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.92 --model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load":true,"num_threads":8}' \
    --trust-remote-code --reasoning-parser glm45 --tool-call-parser glm47 --enable-multimodal \
    --limit-mm-data-per-request '{"image": 1}' \
    --mm-process-config '{"image": {"min_image_tokens": 16, "max_image_tokens": 8000}}' \
    --mm-preprocess-cache-size-mb 0 --mm-enable-dp-encoder --mm-attention-backend aiter_attn
  ```
- Benchmark, per concurrency 16, 32 and 64, two measured runs each after one warm-up pass:
  ```bash
  python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang-oai-chat --dataset-name image \
    --image-resolution 512x512 --image-count 1 --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 128 \
    --random-range-ratio 0.8 --request-rate inf --seed 42 --max-concurrency "$c" --num-prompts $((10 * c))
  ```

</details>

- Arms: fp8 (the default); fp8 with `AITER_MEGAMOE_TP_LB_MT=4 AITER_MEGAMOE_TP_LB_NPP=2` (AITER's large-batch schedule, read by AITER, not set by this PR); bf16 with the same LB variables. Launch order: baseline, fp8, fp8 LB, fp8, baseline; then baseline, bf16, fp8 LB, bf16, baseline.

fp8 against baseline:

| Concurrency | Output tok/s | TTFT (ms) | TPOT (ms) |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 16 | 613.0 → 681.0 (+11.1%) | 330.8 → 277.4 (-16.2%) | 22.93 → 20.80 (-9.3%) |
| 32 | 797.8 → 873.5 (+9.5%) | 456.5 → 408.3 (-10.6%) | 35.92 → 32.84 (-8.6%) |
| 64 | 981.7 → 1068.9 (+8.9%) | 631.0 → 590.2 (-6.5%) | 59.41 → 54.42 (-8.4%) |

Mean output-throughput change over the three concurrencies, each arm against the baseline launches of its own block:

| Arm | Change | SE (pp) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| fp8 | +9.82% | 0.51 |
| fp8, LB 4 / 2 | +11.06% | 0.44 |
| bf16, LB 4 / 2 | +10.43% | 0.51 |

- TTFT and TPOT improve at every concurrency in every arm. The differences between arms (+1.24 pp for LB, -0.63 pp for bf16) are within noise.
- SE: from 12 earlier baseline launches of the same command on the same GPUs (another SGLang build), scaled to each arm's launch count. Baseline against baseline within the blocks: -0.06% and -1.14%.
- Every patched launch logs `AITER MegaMoE-TP enabled: 42 MoE layers, ...`; no baseline launch does.
- Load cost per rank, option on against off: +22.56 GB after weight loading, KV pool -13.4% (15.51 M → 13.42 M tokens), launch to healthy 97 → 168 s.

Per MoE layer, GLM-5.3-Flash shape at TP 2 (random MXFP4 weights), slowest rank's median of 50 iterations, from `benchmark/kernels/aiter_mega_moe_tp/benchmark_aiter_mega_moe_tp.py` (`torchrun --nproc_per_node=2`). | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1024 | 772-781 | 484 (-37.9%) | 468 (-39.6%) | 518 (-33.0%) |
| 2048 | 965-984 | 828 (-15.8%) | 645 (-33.8%) | 754 (-23.3%) |
| 4096 | 1460-1475 | 1356 (-8.0%) | 1145 (-21.7%) | 1362 (-7.3%) |

**With the shared expert fused (#46578)**

- Arms: #46578 alone (baseline) and with `--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp` (fp8, AITER's default schedule). Launch order: baseline, patched, patched, baseline.

| Concurrency | Output tok/s | TTFT (ms) | TPOT (ms) |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |

| 32 | 905.1 → 949.1 (+4.86%) | 395.1 → 359.1 (-9.09%) | 31.57 → 30.31 (-3.99%) |
| 64 | 1131.9 → 1169.4 (+3.31%) | 517.4 → 511.7 (-1.11%) | 51.75 → 49.98 (-3.44%) |

+"""One MoE layer, one forward: stock AITER fused MoE + TP all-reduce vs AITER MegaMoE-TP.
+
+    torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 benchmark/kernels/aiter_mega_moe_tp/benchmark_aiter_mega_moe_tp.py
+    torchrun --nproc_per_node=4 benchmark/kernels/aiter_mega_moe_tp/benchmark_aiter_mega_moe_tp.py \
+        --tokens 1024 2048 --comm-dtype bf16
+
+Needs ROCm gfx950, AITER with ``aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp`` and at least 2 GPUs.
+
+Shape: hidden 4096, MoE intermediate 2048 split over the TP ranks, 288 routed experts plus
+one shared expert (expert 288, weight 1) so 289 experts and top-k 8 + 1, MXFP4 weights
+(``shuffle_weight`` (16, 16) and ``e8m0_shuffle``). Both arms run the same weights, routing
+and inputs, in the 289-expert layout:
+
+  stock      ``aiter.fused_moe.fused_moe`` as the Quark MXFP4 MoE scheme calls it on gfx950
+             (per_1x32, separated gate/up rows), then ``dist.all_reduce`` (RCCL) of the output.
+             The all-reduce is not SGLang's custom all-reduce, and the shared expert is fused
+             into ``fused_moe`` here, while a TP 2 server with ``--disable-shared-experts-fusion``
+             runs it separately. The stock timings therefore differ from a serving baseline.
+  MegaMoE-TP one ``MegaMoeTP`` call in ``comm_mode="ar"``: routed experts, shared expert and
+             the all-reduce in one kernel. ``AITER_MEGAMOE_TP_LB_*`` tune its large-batch
+             schedule and are read by AITER; the values in effect are printed.
+
+Token counts that are not a multiple of the TP size are rounded up for both arms (the kernel
+takes a multiple of tp rows). Each iteration is timed with device events after a barrier, so
+all ranks start together. The reported time is the slowest rank's median.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import statistics
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+HIDDEN = 4096
+MOE_INTER = 2048  # global; each rank holds MOE_INTER // tp
+ROUTED = 288
+TOPK = 8  # routed; the shared expert is a ninth column
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--tokens", type=int, nargs="+", default=[1024, 1404, 2048, 4096]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10)
+    parser.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=50)
+    parser.add_argument("--comm-dtype", choices=["fp8", "bf16"], default="fp8")
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1234)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.warmup < 10:
+        parser.error("--warmup must be at least 10")
+    return args
+
+
+def build_weights(rank, device, inter, seed):
+    """Random MXFP4 weights of this rank's intermediate slice, in the kernels' layout."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    experts = ROUTED + 1
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed + rank)
+
+    def stack(rows, cols, exponent):
+        codes = torch.randint(
+            0,
+            256,
+            (experts, rows, cols // 2),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=device,
+            generator=gen,
+        )
+        scales = torch.randint(
+            exponent,
+            exponent + 3,
+            (experts, rows, cols // 32),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=device,
+            generator=gen,
+        )
+        shuffled_scales = e8m0_shuffle(scales.view(experts * rows, -1))
+        return (
+            shuffle_weight(codes, layout=(16, 16)),
+            shuffled_scales.view(experts, rows, -1),
+        )
+
+    w1, w1_scale = stack(2 * inter, HIDDEN, 119)
+    w2, w2_scale = stack(HIDDEN, inter, 120)
+    return w1, w1_scale, w2, w2_scale
+
+
+def make_inputs(tokens, device, seed):
+    """Replicated activations and routing: 8 distinct routed experts plus the shared one."""
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed + tokens)
+    x = torch.randn(tokens, HIDDEN, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen)
+    scores = torch.rand(tokens, ROUTED, device=device, generator=gen)
+    ids = scores.topk(TOPK, dim=-1).indices
+    weights = torch.softmax(torch.randn(tokens, TOPK, device=device, generator=gen), -1)
+    ids = torch.cat([ids, torch.full_like(ids[:, :1], ROUTED)], dim=1).to(torch.int32)
+    weights = torch.cat([weights, torch.ones_like(weights[:, :1])], dim=1)
+    for tensor in (x, ids, weights):
+        dist.broadcast(tensor, src=0)
+    return x, ids.contiguous(), weights.float().contiguous()
+
+
+def median_us(fn, warmup, iters):
+    for _ in range(warmup):
+        fn()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    times = []
+    for _ in range(iters):
+        dist.barrier()
+        start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        start.record()
+        fn()
+        end.record()
+        end.synchronize()
+        times.append(start.elapsed_time(end) * 1e3)
+    slowest = torch.tensor([statistics.median(times)], device="cuda")
+    dist.all_reduce(slowest, op=dist.ReduceOp.MAX)
+    return float(slowest)
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])
+    world = int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    device = torch.device("cuda", int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank)))
+    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl", device_id=device)
+    cpu_group = dist.new_group(backend="gloo")
+
+    from aiter import ActivationType, QuantType
+    from aiter.fused_moe import fused_moe
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp import MegaMoeTP, MegaMoeTPConfig
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_common import GateMode
+
+    inter = MOE_INTER // world
+    rows = sorted({-(-tokens // world) * world for tokens in args.tokens})
+    w1, w1_scale, w2, w2_scale = build_weights(rank, device, inter, args.seed)
+
+    fp4 = getattr(torch, "float4_e2m1fn_x2", None)
+    stock_w1 = w1.view(fp4) if fp4 is not None else w1
+    stock_w2 = w2.view(fp4) if fp4 is not None else w2
+    stock_w1.is_shuffled = stock_w2.is_shuffled = True
+
+    def stock(x, ids, weights):
+        out = fused_moe(
+            x,
+            stock_w1,
+            stock_w2,
+            weights,
+            ids,
+            quant_type=QuantType.per_1x32,
+            activation=ActivationType.Silu,
+            w1_scale=w1_scale,
+            w2_scale=w2_scale,
+            gate_mode=GateMode.SEPARATED.value,
+        )
+        dist.all_reduce(out)
+        return out
+
+    comm_dtype, ar_gather = (
+        ("fp8", "auto") if args.comm_dtype == "fp8" else ("bf16", "bf16")
+    )
+    kernel = MegaMoeTP(
+        MegaMoeTPConfig(
+            rank=rank,
+            world_size=world,
+            model_dim=HIDDEN,
+            inter_dim=inter,
+            experts=ROUTED + 1,
+            topk=TOPK + 1,
+            max_local_tokens=max(rows) // world,
+            activation=ActivationType.Silu,
+            comm_mode="ar",
+            comm_dtype=comm_dtype,
+            ar_gather=ar_gather,
+        ),
+        w1=w1,
+        w1_scale=w1_scale,
+        w2=w2,
+        w2_scale=w2_scale,
+        group=cpu_group,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    kernel.prepare(sorted({m // world for m in rows}))
+
+    if rank == 0:
+        lb_env = {
+            k: v
+            for k, v in sorted(os.environ.items())
+            if k.startswith("AITER_MEGAMOE_TP")
+        }
+        print(
+            f"device {torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).gcnArchName}, TP {world}, "
+            f"hidden {HIDDEN}, intermediate/rank {inter}, experts {ROUTED}+1, top-k {TOPK}+1, "
+            f"comm {args.comm_dtype}, warmup {args.warmup}, iters {args.iters}, "
+            f"AITER_MEGAMOE_TP env {lb_env or 'unset'}"
+        )
+        print(
+            "| tokens | stock us | MegaMoE-TP us | speedup % | stock tok/s | MegaMoE-TP tok/s | rel L2 |"
+        )
+        print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
+
+    for tokens in rows:
+        x, ids, weights = make_inputs(tokens, device, args.seed)
+        out = torch.empty_like(x)
+
+        def fused():
+            kernel(x, weights, ids, out=out)
+
+        reference = stock(x, ids, weights)
+        fused()
+        error = float(
+            (out.float() - reference.float()).norm() / reference.float().norm()
+        )
+        stock_us = median_us(lambda: stock(x, ids, weights), args.warmup, args.iters)
+        fused_us = median_us(fused, args.warmup, args.iters)
+        if rank == 0:
+            print(
+                f"| {tokens} | {stock_us:.0f} | {fused_us:.0f} | "
+                f"{(stock_us - fused_us) / stock_us * 100:+.1f} | "
+                f"{tokens / stock_us * 1e6:.0f} | {tokens / fused_us * 1e6:.0f} | {error:.4f} |"
+            )
+    dist.barrier()
+    dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Opt-in AITER MegaMoE-TP for the eager extend forwards of TP MoE layers.
+
+``--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp`` runs a layer's routed experts, shared expert and TP
+all-reduce as one persistent AITER kernel (``aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp``, ``ar``
+mode); its docstring states the collective, whole-GPU and watchdog contract. Only eager
+extend forwards of up to ``SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_MAX_TOKENS`` tokens take it, and
+every gate reads values equal on all TP ranks. Decode, CUDA graphs, torch.compile and
+larger forwards keep the stock path. A timed-out kernel wait is raised, ending the
+server, by a later eligible forward on the rank that observes it. The kernel binds the
+expert weights at load, so online weight updates are rejected.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import get_is_capture_mode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_backend_utils.tc_piecewise_cuda_graph import (
+    is_in_tc_piecewise_cuda_graph,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec, get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import ceil_div, log_info_on_rank0, print_info_once
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+    from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v2 import DeepseekV2MoE
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_EXTEND_MODES = (ForwardMode.EXTEND, ForwardMode.MIXED)
+# Launch epochs are int32 in the kernel; reset() (collective) long before they wrap.
+_RESET_PERIOD = 2**30
+_WEIGHT_NAMES = {
+    "w1": "w13_weight",
+    "w1_scale": "w13_weight_scale",
+    "w2": "w2_weight",
+    "w2_scale": "w2_weight_scale",
+}
+# Read by WeightUpdater through `_derived_weight_cache_error` on any module.
+_WEIGHT_UPDATE_ERROR = (
+    "Online weight updates are not supported with --enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp: the "
+    "kernel is bound to the expert weights loaded at startup. Restart without it to "
+    "use online weight updates."
+)
+
+
+def comm_options(comm_dtype: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """``(comm_dtype, ar_gather)`` of ``MegaMoeTPConfig`` for the env's value."""
+    if comm_dtype == "fp8":
+        return "fp8", "auto"
+    if comm_dtype == "bf16":
+        return "bf16", "bf16"
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_COMM_DTYPE must be 'fp8' or 'bf16', got {comm_dtype!r}"
+    )
+
+
+def capture_reason() -> Optional[str]:
+    if (
+        get_is_capture_mode()
+        or is_in_tc_piecewise_cuda_graph()
+        or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+    ):
+        return "CUDA graph capture or replay"
+    return None
+
+
+def stock_reason(
+    num_tokens: int, dtype: torch.dtype, is_extend: bool, max_tokens: int
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Why a forward takes the stock path (a fixed string per reason), or None."""
+    if not is_extend:
+        return "a decode or other non-extend forward"
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return "an empty forward"
+    if num_tokens > max_tokens:
+        return "a forward above SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_MAX_TOKENS"
+    if dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        return "a non-bf16 MoE input"
+    return None
+
+
+class _ArRows:
+    """Row buffers for ``ar`` mode, which takes a multiple of tp rows: tp - 1 pad rows
+    (zero input and weights, distinct valid ids) sit in front of the token rows, so a
+    call is one contiguous slice and the pad rows are written once."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tp, max_tokens, hidden_size, topk, shared_id, device):
+        self.tp, self.first = tp, tp - 1
+        rows = self.first + max_tokens
+        self.x = torch.zeros(rows, hidden_size, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        self.ids = torch.arange(topk, dtype=torch.int32, device=device).repeat(rows, 1)
+        self.weights = torch.zeros(rows, topk, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        if shared_id is not None:
+            self.ids[self.first :, -1] = shared_id
+            self.weights[self.first :, -1] = 1.0
+
+    def fill(self, x, topk_ids, topk_weights) -> tuple[int, slice]:
+        """Stage a forward; returns its pad rows and the slice of every buffer to launch."""
+        num_tokens, k = topk_ids.shape
+        end = self.first + num_tokens
+        pad = -num_tokens % self.tp  # rows that complete a multiple of tp
+        self.ids[self.first : end, :k].copy_(topk_ids)
+        self.weights[self.first : end, :k].copy_(topk_weights)
+        if pad:
+            self.x[self.first : end].copy_(x)
+        return pad, slice(self.first - pad, end)
+
+
+class _Runner:
+    """One MegaMoeTP shared by all hosted layers (one symmetric arena per rank)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, kernel, rows, max_tokens, layer_ids, err_host, err_event):
+        self.kernel, self.rows, self.max_tokens = kernel, rows, max_tokens
+        self.first_layer, self.last_layer = min(layer_ids), max(layer_ids)
+        self.err_host, self.err_event = err_host, err_event
+        self.launches = 0
+
+    def run(self, layer_id, weights, x, topk_ids, topk_weights) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # The flag is copied to pinned memory after the last layer: reading it here
+        # neither synchronizes nor blocks, and a copy still in flight is checked later.
+        if layer_id == self.first_layer and self.err_event.query() and self.err_host[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AITER MegaMoE-TP: a kernel wait timed out (ranks out of step); MoE "
+                "outputs since then are invalid"
+            )
+        self.launches += 1
+        if self.launches % _RESET_PERIOD == 0:
+            self.kernel.reset()
+        self.kernel.set_weights(**weights)
+        pad, rows = self.rows.fill(x, topk_ids, topk_weights)
+        route = (self.rows.weights[rows], self.rows.ids[rows])
+        out = x.new_empty(x.shape)
+        if pad:
+            out.copy_(self.kernel(self.rows.x[rows], *route)[pad:])
+        else:
+            self.kernel(x, *route, out=out)
+        if layer_id == self.last_layer:
+            self.err_host.copy_(self.kernel.error_flag(), non_blocking=True)
+            self.err_event.record()
+        return out
+
+
+class _Hosted(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Per-block state: the shared runner and this layer's kernel weights."""
+
+    runner: Optional[_Runner] = None
+    weights: Optional[dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = None
+
+
+def _refuse(moe, reason: str):
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp is not supported for MoE layer {moe.layer_id}: "
+        f"{reason}."
+    )
+
+
+def _aiter_mega_moe_tp():
+    try:
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl import mega_moe_tp
+    except ImportError as e:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp needs an AITER with "
+            f"aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp (ROCm/aiter#5937): {e}"
+        ) from e
+    if not mega_moe_tp.mega_moe_tp_supported():
+        raise ValueError("--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp needs a gfx950 GPU")
+    return mega_moe_tp
+
+
+def register(moe: DeepseekV2MoE) -> None:
+    """Host a sparse block (decoder ``__init__``); ValueError if it cannot run the kernel."""
+    if not get_exec().moe.enable_aiter_mega_moe_tp:
+        moe._mega_moe_tp = None
+        return
+    _aiter_mega_moe_tp()
+    experts, fused = moe.experts, moe.num_fused_shared_experts
+    runner_config, backend = experts.moe_runner_config, experts.runner_backend
+    for refused, reason in (
+        (backend is None or not backend.is_aiter(), "its MoE runner is not aiter"),
+        (moe.is_hash, "hash routing"),
+        (moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias_vl is not None, "vision routing bias"),
+        (moe.topk.enable_waterfill, "waterfill top-k"),
+        (
+            not moe.routed_scaling_factor_fused_in_topk,
+            "the routed scaling factor is not folded into the top-k weights",
+        ),
+        (
+            runner_config.activation != "silu"
+            or not runner_config.is_gated
+            or experts.with_bias,
+            "the experts are not bias-free gated SiLU",
+        ),
+        (
+            fused > 1
+            or (fused == 0 and not hasattr(moe, "shared_experts"))
+            or (fused == 0 and moe._shared_expert_tp1),
+            "it needs exactly one shared expert, fused or TP-sharded",
+        ),
+    ):
+        if refused:
+            _refuse(moe, reason)
+    moe._mega_moe_tp = _Hosted()
+
+
+def _shared_expert_shard(moe) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """This rank's unfused shared expert as one slot, preshuffled like the routed ones."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    gate_up, down = moe.shared_experts.gate_up_proj, moe.shared_experts.down_proj
+    # These paths store the weight in another layout than the checkpoint's.
+    if any(
+        getattr(proj, flag, False)
+        for proj in (gate_up, down)
+        for flag in ("use_aiter_asm_fp4_gemm", "dequantized_bf16")
+    ):
+        _refuse(moe, "the shared expert is not on the MXFP4 Triton GEMM path")
+    shard = {}
+    for (key, scale_key), proj in (
+        (("w1", "w1_scale"), gate_up),
+        (("w2", "w2_scale"), down),
+    ):
+        scale = proj.weight_scale.data
+        shard[key] = shuffle_weight(proj.weight.data.contiguous()[None], (16, 16))
+        shard[scale_key] = e8m0_shuffle(scale.contiguous()).view(1, *scale.shape)
+    return shard
+
+
+def _kernel_weights(moe) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The kernel's four weight tensors, with the shared expert as the last slot.
+
+    A fused shared expert already is that slot. An unfused one is re-homed once into a
+    one-slot-larger buffer; the parameters view its first slots, so the stock path reads
+    the same values."""
+    experts = moe.experts
+    params = {key: getattr(experts, name) for key, name in _WEIGHT_NAMES.items()}
+    if not getattr(experts.w13_weight, "is_shuffled", False) or any(
+        p.dtype != torch.uint8 for p in params.values()
+    ):
+        _refuse(moe, "the experts are not preshuffled MXFP4 (uint8) tensors")
+    if moe.num_fused_shared_experts:
+        return {key: p.data for key, p in params.items()}
+    shared = _shared_expert_shard(moe)
+    weights = {}
+    for key, param in params.items():
+        slot = shared[key]
+        if slot.shape[1:] != param.shape[1:] or slot.dtype != param.dtype:
+            _refuse(
+                moe,
+                f"the shared expert's {_WEIGHT_NAMES[key]} is {tuple(slot.shape[1:])} "
+                f"{slot.dtype}, the routed experts' {tuple(param.shape[1:])} {param.dtype}",
+            )
+        full = torch.empty(
+            (param.shape[0] + 1, *param.shape[1:]),
+            dtype=param.dtype,
+            device=param.device,
+        )
+        full[:-1].copy_(param.data)
+        full[-1:].copy_(slot)
+        param.data = full[:-1]
+        weights[key] = full
+    # The old blocks are too small for the next layer's larger ones: return them now.
+    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+    return weights
+
+
+def _build_runner(blocks, weights) -> _Runner:
+    from aiter import ActivationType
+
+    mega_moe_tp = _aiter_mega_moe_tp()
+    tp = get_parallel().tp_group
+    experts = blocks[0].experts
+    runner_config = experts.moe_runner_config
+    appended = not blocks[0].num_fused_shared_experts
+    num_experts, inter_dim2, packed_hidden = weights[0]["w1"].shape
+    topk = runner_config.top_k + int(appended)
+    max_tokens = envs.SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_MAX_TOKENS.get()
+    local_tokens = ceil_div(max_tokens, tp.world_size)
+    comm_dtype, ar_gather = comm_options(envs.SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_COMM_DTYPE.get())
+    try:
+        kernel = mega_moe_tp.MegaMoeTP(
+            mega_moe_tp.MegaMoeTPConfig(
+                rank=tp.rank_in_group,
+                world_size=tp.world_size,
+                model_dim=packed_hidden * 2,
+                inter_dim=inter_dim2 // 2,
+                experts=num_experts,
+                topk=topk,
+                max_local_tokens=local_tokens,
+                activation=ActivationType.Silu,
+                swiglu_limit=runner_config.swiglu_limit,
+                comm_mode="ar",
+                comm_dtype=comm_dtype,
+                ar_gather=ar_gather,
+            ),
+            **weights[0],
+            group=tp.cpu_group,
+            device=experts.w13_weight.device,
+        )
+    except ValueError as e:  # also MegaMoeTPLDSError: the window does not fit
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp: {e} (tp_size={tp.world_size}, "
+            f"SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_MAX_TOKENS={max_tokens})"
+        ) from e
+    # One launch config per distinct schedule, by the smallest local token count.
+    configs = {kernel.launch_config(m): m for m in range(local_tokens, 0, -1)}
+    kernel.prepare(sorted(configs.values()))
+    rows = _ArRows(
+        tp.world_size,
+        max_tokens,
+        packed_hidden * 2,
+        topk,
+        num_experts - 1 if appended else None,
+        experts.w13_weight.device,
+    )
+    log_info_on_rank0(
+        logger,
+        f"AITER MegaMoE-TP enabled: {len(blocks)} MoE layers, {num_experts} experts "
+        f"(shared expert {'appended' if appended else 'fused'}), top-k {topk}, eager "
+        f"extend forwards of 1-{max_tokens} tokens, comm {comm_dtype}, {len(configs)} "
+        "launch configs prepared",
+    )
+    return _Runner(
+        kernel,
+        rows,
+        max_tokens,
+        [b.layer_id for b in blocks],
+        torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True),
+        torch.cuda.Event(),
+    )
+
+
+def finalize(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Collective on every TP rank, after weight postprocessing and before graph capture."""
+    if not get_exec().moe.enable_aiter_mega_moe_tp:
+        return
+    blocks = [
+        m for m in model.modules() if getattr(m, "_mega_moe_tp", None) is not None
+    ]
+    if not blocks:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "--enable-aiter-mega-moe-tp: the model has no MoE layer hosted by a "
+            "MegaMoE-TP-aware decoder"
+        )
+    weights = [_kernel_weights(block) for block in blocks]
+    runner = _build_runner(blocks, weights)
+    for block, block_weights in zip(blocks, weights, strict=True):
+        block._mega_moe_tp.runner, block._mega_moe_tp.weights = runner, block_weights
+        block._derived_weight_cache_error = _WEIGHT_UPDATE_ERROR
+

+def maybe_forward(
+    moe: DeepseekV2MoE,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    forward_batch: ForwardBatch,

+) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """The block's TP-reduced output, or None for the stock path (logged once a reason)."""
+    # The compiled graph holds the stock path; a logger call here would break the trace.
+    if torch.compiler.is_compiling():
+        return None
+    hosted = moe._mega_moe_tp
+    # No runner: the block belongs to a model that was never finalized (a draft).
+    if hosted is None or hosted.runner is None:
+        return None
+    runner = hosted.runner
+    reason = capture_reason() or stock_reason(
+        hidden_states.shape[0],
+        hidden_states.dtype,
+        forward_batch.forward_mode in _EXTEND_MODES,
+        runner.max_tokens,
+    )
+    if reason is not None:
+        print_info_once(f"AITER MegaMoE-TP: stock MoE path for {reason}")
+        return None
+    # The layers package must not import models at load time.
+    from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.amd import deepseek_v2_hip_moe
+
+    # Routing as DeepseekV2MoE.forward_normal; hash and vision routing are refused.
+    router_logits, partials = deepseek_v2_hip_moe.forward_gate(
+        moe, hidden_states, gemm_output_zero_allocator, fused_gate=True
+    )
+    kwargs = {} if partials is None else {"router_logits_partials": partials}
+    topk_output = moe.topk(hidden_states, router_logits, **kwargs)
+    return runner.run(
+        moe.layer_id,
+        hosted.weights,
+        hidden_states,
+        topk_output.topk_ids,
+        topk_output.topk_weights,
+    )

+"""AITER MegaMoE-TP on 2 GPUs: the integration path against a pure-PyTorch MXFP4 reference.
+
+Drives ``register`` / ``finalize`` / ``maybe_forward`` on two hosted layers with synthetic
+MXFP4 weights at TP 2, with the unfused shared expert appended to the routed experts and
+fp8 communication, at a row count that needs no pad and one that needs a pad row. One
+process per rank. Needs ROCm gfx950, AITER with ``aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp`` and 2 GPUs.
+
+The kernel is lossy by design (MXFP4 activations, fp8 communication), so the reference
+applies the same activation quantization.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+import sglang.srt.layers.moe.aiter_mega_moe_tp as mmtp

+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import MoeRunnerBackend
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.quant_ref_utils import break_fp4_bytes

+
+# gfx950 only; the test uses 2 of the lane's 8 GPUs.

+

+INTER = 256  # per rank

+
+
+def _dequant_mxfp4(packed, scale):
+    """packed uint8 [..., K // 2] (two E2M1 codes, low nibble first), scale uint8
+    [..., K // 32] (E8M0, bias 127) -> fp32 [..., K]."""
+    values = break_fp4_bytes(packed.flatten(0, -2)).view(*packed.shape[:-1], -1)
+    scales = torch.exp2(scale.float() - 127).unsqueeze(-1)
+    return (values.unflatten(-1, (-1, 32)) * scales).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def _quant_dequant_mxfp4(x):
+    """Activations as the kernel quantizes them: per 32 values an E8M0 scale of
+    ceil_pow2(amax / 6) and E2M1 codes rounded to nearest even."""
+    blocks = x.float().unflatten(-1, (-1, 32))
+    amax = blocks.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+    scale = torch.exp2(torch.ceil(torch.log2(amax / 6)).clamp(-127, 127))
+    scaled = (blocks / scale).abs()
+    # E2M1 spacing: 0.5 below 2, 1 in [2, 4), 2 from 4 up to the maximum 6.
+    step = 0.5 * (1 + (scaled >= 2).float() + 2 * (scaled >= 4).float())
+    quantized = (torch.round(scaled / step) * step).clamp(max=6)
+    return (quantized.copysign(blocks) * scale).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def _reference_partial(x, ids, weights, w13, w2):
+    """sum_k w_k * down(silu(gate) * up) over one rank's slice of the intermediate dim.
+    w13 [E, 2 * inter, H] and w2 [E, H, inter] are dequantized."""
+    quantized_x = _quant_dequant_mxfp4(x)
+    out = torch.zeros(x.shape[0], w2.shape[1], dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    for expert in range(w13.shape[0]):
+        token, slot = (ids == expert).nonzero(as_tuple=True)
+        if token.numel() == 0:
+            continue
+        gate, up = (quantized_x[token] @ w13[expert].T).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        activated = _quant_dequant_mxfp4(torch.nn.functional.silu(gate) * up)
+        weight = weights[token, slot].unsqueeze(-1)
+        out.index_add_(0, token, (activated @ w2[expert].T) * weight)
+    return out
+
+
+# --- synthetic weights --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _shard(layer, rank, device):
+    """Raw (unshuffled) MXFP4 weights of one layer and rank: ROUTED experts and, at
+    index ROUTED, the shared expert. Random codes; scales of magnitude about 2**-6."""
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1000 * layer + rank)
+
+    def stack(rows, cols, exponent):
+        codes = torch.randint(
+            0, 256, (ROUTED + 1, rows, cols // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, generator=gen
+        )
+        scales = torch.randint(
+            exponent,
+            exponent + 3,
+            (ROUTED + 1, rows, cols // 32),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            generator=gen,
+        )
+        return codes.to(device), scales.to(device)
+
+    w13, w13_scale = stack(2 * INTER, HIDDEN, 120)
+    w2, w2_scale = stack(HIDDEN, INTER, 121)
+    return dict(w13=w13, w13_scale=w13_scale, w2=w2, w2_scale=w2_scale)
+
+
+def _block(layer, raw):
+    """A hosted MoE block as the loader leaves it: the routed experts preshuffled, the
+    shared expert in its dense layers' checkpoint layout."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    def param(tensor):
+        return torch.nn.Parameter(tensor, requires_grad=False)
+
+    def shuffled(weight, scale):
+        rows = scale.shape[1]
+        flat = e8m0_shuffle(scale[:ROUTED].reshape(ROUTED * rows, -1))
+        return (
+            param(shuffle_weight(weight[:ROUTED].contiguous(), (16, 16))),
+            param(flat.view(ROUTED, rows, -1)),
+        )
+
+    experts = SimpleNamespace(
+        runner_backend=MoeRunnerBackend.AITER,
+        with_bias=False,
+        moe_runner_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            activation="silu", is_gated=True, top_k=TOPK, swiglu_limit=None
+        ),
+    )
+    experts.w13_weight, experts.w13_weight_scale = shuffled(
+        raw["w13"], raw["w13_scale"]
+    )
+    experts.w2_weight, experts.w2_weight_scale = shuffled(raw["w2"], raw["w2_scale"])
+    experts.w13_weight.is_shuffled = True
+
+    block = torch.nn.Module()
+    block.layer_id = layer
+    block.experts = experts
+    block.num_fused_shared_experts = 0
+    block.is_hash = False
+    block.routed_scaling_factor_fused_in_topk = True
+    block._shared_expert_tp1 = False
+    block.gate = SimpleNamespace(e_score_correction_bias_vl=None)
+    block.shared_experts = SimpleNamespace(
+        gate_up_proj=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=param(raw["w13"][ROUTED].clone()),
+            weight_scale=param(raw["w13_scale"][ROUTED].clone()),
+        ),
+        down_proj=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=param(raw["w2"][ROUTED].clone()),
+            weight_scale=param(raw["w2_scale"][ROUTED].clone()),
+        ),
+    )
+    return block
+
+
+class _Router:
+    """The block's top-k: returns the routing the test staged."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.enable_waterfill, self.staged = False, None
+
+    def stage(self, ids, weights):
+        self.staged = SimpleNamespace(topk_ids=ids, topk_weights=weights)
+
+    def __call__(self, hidden_states, router_logits, **kwargs):
+        return self.staged
+
+
+def _routing(tokens, layer, device):
+    """Replicated x, routed ids and weights (broadcast from rank 0)."""
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(7 * tokens + layer)
+    x = torch.randn(tokens, HIDDEN, generator=gen).to(device, torch.bfloat16)
+    ids = torch.rand(tokens, ROUTED, generator=gen).topk(TOPK).indices.to(device)
+    weights = torch.softmax(torch.randn(tokens, TOPK, generator=gen), dim=-1).to(device)
+    for tensor in (x, ids, weights):
+        dist.broadcast(tensor, src=0)
+    return x, ids, weights
+
+
+# --- one rank ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _check(rank):
+    device = torch.device("cuda", rank)
+    cpu_group = dist.new_group(backend="gloo")
+    mmtp.get_exec = lambda: SimpleNamespace(
+        moe=SimpleNamespace(enable_aiter_mega_moe_tp=True)
+    )
+    mmtp.get_parallel = lambda: SimpleNamespace(
+        tp_group=SimpleNamespace(
+            rank_in_group=rank, world_size=WORLD_SIZE, cpu_group=cpu_group
+        )
+    )
+    envs.SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_MAX_TOKENS.set(MAX_TOKENS)
+    envs.SGLANG_AITER_MEGA_MOE_TP_COMM_DTYPE.set("fp8")
+    import sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.amd.deepseek_v2_hip_moe as hip_moe
+
+    # Routing is staged by the test: only the kernel path is under test.
+    hip_moe.forward_gate = lambda moe, hidden, allocator, *, fused_gate: (None, None)
+
+    # Every rank's raw shards: the reference sums the partial of each rank's slice.
+    shards = [
+        [_shard(layer, r, device) for r in range(WORLD_SIZE)]
+        for layer in range(NUM_LAYERS)
+    ]
+    dequantized = [
+        [
+            (
+                _dequant_mxfp4(s["w13"], s["w13_scale"]),
+                _dequant_mxfp4(s["w2"], s["w2_scale"]),
+            )
+            for s in layer_shards
+        ]
+        for layer_shards in shards
+    ]
+    blocks = [_block(layer, shards[layer][rank]) for layer in range(NUM_LAYERS)]
+    routers = [_Router() for _ in blocks]
+    for block, router in zip(blocks, routers, strict=True):
+        block.topk = router
+    model = torch.nn.Sequential(*blocks)
+    stock_w13 = [b.experts.w13_weight.data.clone() for b in blocks]
+
+    for block in blocks:
+        mmtp.register(block)
+    mmtp.finalize(model)
+
+    # The stock path keeps reading the routed experts it always read.
+    for block, before in zip(blocks, stock_w13, strict=True):
+        assert block.experts.w13_weight.shape[0] == ROUTED
+        assert torch.equal(block.experts.w13_weight.data, before)
+
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND)
+    for tokens in TOKENS:
+        for layer, (block, router) in enumerate(zip(blocks, routers, strict=True)):
+            x, ids, weights = _routing(tokens, layer, device)
+            router.stage(ids, weights)
+            out = mmtp.maybe_forward(block, x, batch)
+            assert out is not None, f"{tokens} tokens took the stock path"
+            assert out.shape == x.shape and out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+
+            full_ids = torch.cat([ids, torch.full_like(ids[:, :1], ROUTED)], dim=1)
+            full_weights = torch.cat([weights, torch.ones_like(weights[:, :1])], dim=1)
+            reference = sum(
+                _reference_partial(x, full_ids, full_weights, *dequantized[layer][r])
+                for r in range(WORLD_SIZE)
+            )
+            error = (out.float() - reference).norm() / reference.norm()
+            cosine = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
+                out.float(), reference, dim=-1
+            ).min()
+            assert error <= REL_L2, (
+                f"{tokens} tokens layer {layer}: rel L2 {error:.4f} > {REL_L2}"
+            )
+            assert cosine >= MIN_COSINE, (
+                f"{tokens} tokens layer {layer}: row cosine {cosine:.4f} < {MIN_COSINE}"
+            )
+
+            replicas = [torch.empty_like(out) for _ in range(WORLD_SIZE)]
+            dist.all_gather(replicas, out)
+            assert all(torch.equal(replicas[0], r) for r in replicas), "ranks differ"
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _kernel_available(),
+    reason="needs ROCm gfx950 with aiter.ops.flydsl.mega_moe_tp",
+)
+def test_mega_moe_tp_matches_the_mxfp4_reference():
+    if torch.cuda.device_count() < WORLD_SIZE:
+        pytest.skip(f"needs {WORLD_SIZE} GPUs")
+    run_distributed_test(_check, world_size=WORLD_SIZE)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
